query:
WITH lr AS (
                SELECT
                    coalesce(bool_or(is_last_resort)
                        FILTER (WHERE is_apq = true), false) AS has
                FROM qs_staged_key_package
                WHERE batch_id = $1
            )
            DELETE FROM apq_key_package
            WHERE user_id = $2
                AND (NOT is_last_resort OR (SELECT has FROM lr))
